title: Virtual screening identified natural Keap1-Nrf2 PPI inhibitor alleviates inflammatory osteoporosis through Nrf2-mir214-Traf3 axis.
authors: Hong, Jianqiao; Shi, Zhongli; Li, Congsun; Ji, Xiaoxiao; Li, Sihao; Chen, Yazhou; Jiang, Guangyao; Shi, Mingmin; Wang, Wei; Zhang, Yongxing; Hu, Bin; Yan, Shigui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选发现Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂并研究其抗炎性骨丢失机制，虽涉及Nrf2与DNA启动子结合（ChIP-seq），但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅用于初步筛选，与本课题匹配度低。
abstract: Overactive osteoclastogenesis is involved in the inflammatory bone loss and could be target for therapy. Here, we applied transcription factor enrichment analysis using public inflammatory osteolysis datasets and identified Nrf2 as the potential therapeutic target. Additionally, in-silico screening was performed to dig out Nrf2-Keap1 PPI inhibitor and Forsythoside-beta was found to be the best-performing PHG compound. We firstly tested the effect of Forsythoside-beta in inflammatory osteoporosis models and found it was able to attenuate the bone loss by inhibiting osteoclastogenesis and activating Nrf2-signaling in vivo. Forsythoside-beta was capable to suppress the differentiation of osteoclast in time and dose-dependent manners in vitro. Further, Forsythoside-beta could inhibit the production of reactive oxygen species and induce Nrf2 nuclear-translocation by interrupting Nrf2-Keap1 PPI. Recently, Nrf2 was identified as the epigenetic regulator modulating levels of miRNA in various diseases. We discovered that Forsythoside-beta could suppress the expression of mir-214-3p, one of most variable miRNAs during osteoclastogenesis. To clarify the undermining mechanism, by utilizing chip-seq dataset, we found that Nrf2 could bind to promoter of mir-214-3p and further regulate this miRNA. Collectively, Forsythoside-beta was able to prevent bone loss through Nrf2-mir-214-3p-Traf3 axis, which could be a promising candidate for treating inflammatory bone loss in the future.
abstract_zh: 过度活跃的破骨细胞生成参与炎症性骨丢失，并可能成为治疗靶点。在此，我们利用公共炎症性骨溶解数据集进行转录因子富集分析，并确定Nrf2为潜在治疗靶点。此外，进行了计算机模拟筛选以挖掘Nrf2-Keap1 PPI抑制剂，发现连翘苷β（Forsythoside-beta）是表现最佳的PHG化合物。我们首先在炎症性骨质疏松模型中测试了连翘苷β的效果，发现其能够通过抑制破骨细胞生成并激活体内Nrf2信号通路来减轻骨丢失。连翘苷β在体外能够以时间和剂量依赖性方式抑制破骨细胞分化。进一步地，连翘苷β可通过干扰Nrf2-Keap1 PPI来抑制活性氧的产生并诱导Nrf2核转位。近期，Nrf2被确定为多种疾病中调节miRNA水平的表观遗传调控因子。我们发现连翘苷β能够抑制mir-214-3p的表达，该miRNA是破骨细胞生成过程中变化最显著的miRNA之一。为阐明潜在机制，利用chip-seq数据集，我们发现Nrf2能够结合至mir-214-3p的启动子并进一步调控该miRNA。总之，连翘苷β能够通过Nrf2-mir-214-3p-Traf3轴预防骨丢失，这可能是未来治疗炎症性骨丢失的有前景候选药物。
